01 / Featured case study

Sales Performance
Executive Dashboard

A one-page interactive Excel dashboard that makes revenue, profitability, product mix, and order activity easy to review by region, category, and year.

Business challenge

Make performance visible in one place.

Bring revenue, profit, margin, products, orders, and payment status into a single monthly executive view without manually searching through detailed sales records.

Dashboard solution

Six KPIs, four charts, four ways to filter.

Linked KPI calculations and PivotCharts provide a consistent view, while Region, Category, Year, and Date filters let viewers focus on specific business segments.

02 / What the numbers reveal

Insights behind the visuals.

The best dashboard answers business questions. These findings are calculated from the project's synthetic sales data, using profit as revenue minus cost.

Executive takeaway
↗

The South Region contributes the most total profit, while the North Region has the lowest. Home Office leads category profit, and Accessories has the strongest category margin at approximately 59.6%. Laptops generate the least category profit and have a margin of about 25.7%, making them a priority for profitability review.

From transaction rows
to a decision tool.
